items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: I worked for Sergeant Morrison, Captain Anderson, all them fellas, American Legion, you know.

ctx.x: Yes sir. And then I had a Petone's, uh, fighting arena, the fifth water athletic club. Every Friday. Where was that? That street? That athletic club on the domain between Decatur and Charlotte. And then I had a, uh, on the downtown side of the bank. Cause it was called the Fifth Water Athletic Club. That was every Friday. I had, uh, Fry's Grocery on Canal and Villeary, Food Store. It was advertised for them. I think it was every Tuesday or Wednesday. And... You got on a truck there? Yeah, on a truck. And, uh, it…
